title: Frontend - Apply server-configured defaults to dashboard graph query + UI

requirements: Load EntityImpactGraph settings on dashboard and use them as defaults (minEntityConfidence, maxNodes, thresholds, categories)
If settings disable the chart, hide the card or show an admin-configured disabled message
Keep per-user interactive overrides (e.g., slider) but seed initial state from settings
Update tooltips/labels to reflect correct semantics (confidence vs co-occurrence vs correlation)
acceptance: Dashboard renders with admin-defined defaults without code changes
User overrides apply only to current session/view, not persisted
